criteria.notes: The proof uses the platform weather service, exposes only meaningful editor settings, refreshes predictably, and retains the last good forecast on transient failure.
No external design reference was declared; the cinematic weather-window brief is the visual authority.
Full-bleed weather media, an oversized temperature composition, calibrated detail rules, and an unframed forecast horizon distinguish it from dashboard and card examples.
Hero, secondary, and metadata text remain above the declared room-viewing floors at all maintained target ratios.
The media scrim and solid fallback preserve readable contrast across bright imagery, missing media, stale data, and unavailable states.
Long locations and conditions fit through bounded auto-fit, while forecast metadata remains complete without clipped glyphs or partial lines.
Forecast content changes from a horizontal horizon to a vertical sequence for tall surfaces and intentionally omits secondary details on compact surfaces.
Generated preview media, editor icon, placeholder, cached platform media, and no-media fallback all render without broken assets.
The edge-to-edge editorial composition is deliberately unlike the maintained operational tables, cards, menus, and dashboards.

screenshots.notes: Full-HD hierarchy, weather media, detail rail, and forecast horizon were inspected at rendered size.
Generic landscape keeps the complete hierarchy and vertically stacked detail labels without overlap.
Portrait uses a deliberate vertical forecast sequence with balanced media and readable hero text.
The long condition fits within its bounded region above the secondary text floor.
The long location wraps and fits without clipping or displacing the weather reading.
Missing media falls back to an intentional atmospheric color field and weather mark without a broken image.
The motion-off state remains compositionally complete with decorative drift and reveal effects disabled.
The declared portrait scenario matches the inspected portrait target without hidden or overlapping content.
A short forecast remains intentionally distributed rather than leaving a broken or collapsed horizon.
Square mode prioritizes room-readable current conditions and a compact forecast without overcrowding.
A failed refresh retains the last good forecast and adds a clear but restrained stale-data message.
Initial service failure renders a designed full-surface unavailable state with actionable location guidance.
Wide-low mode forms a compact signage band with readable current conditions and forecast values.
Maintained square preset matches the inspected compact composition and semantic font floors.
Maintained wide-low preset remains fully populated and readable with no accidental clipping.
